fato_historico: 1979: Greensboro massacre: Five members of the Communist Workers Party are shot dead and seven are wounded by a group of Klansmen and neo-Nazis during a "Death to the Klan" rally in Greensboro, North Carolina, United States.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle invitation to cultivate peace within your sanctuary. While history reminds us that even when shadows gather and conflict threatens to darken the path, the resilient spirit remains a beacon of light. Consider how your unwavering stability can help heal and ground those around you during moments of uncertainty or intense collective transformation.
frase_do_dia: Your kindness is the most powerful shield against the storms of the world.
significado_numero: Represents the path toward manifesting deep emotional and spiritual inner wisdom.
conselho: Nurture your garden and choose empathy when you encounter difficult or conflicting energy.
